hypotheses.scope: Comment/application preserve pending GCE; Plain Text and images consume it, including empty text data.
hypotheses.duplicate: Section 23 allows at most one GCE per graphic. Complete last-GCE replacement is an explicit recovery hypothesis, not a spec requirement.
hypotheses.trailing: Well-framed GCE with no following graphic: orphan scope probe, no retroactive effect hypothesized.
hypotheses.canvas: Transparent pixels leave a transparent initial canvas unchanged; later disposal 1 preserves prior pixels.
hypotheses.plain_text: Nonzero 9x7 grid, 1x1 cells, valid GCT, empty text data. No glyph raster claim; Chromium may skip text without consuming GCE. Measurements are retained.

collection.equality: exact complete observation equality, including PNG, SVG, SVG-derived PNG and RGBA
collection.capture: Static probes contain one table image; GCE delays zero except user-input=1 with 65535cs. Two-frame probes hold frame 1 for 65535cs, no user input or loop extension; each capture asserted under 30s.
collection.later_frame_limit: Browser samples establish first display only. Authored frame counts and complete-container validation are JS audit probes, not native later-frame display or production validation qualification.
collection.malformed_controls: Never submitted to Chromium; authored strict/recovery intent and distinct bytes only.

authored_expectation_policy: Explicit integer patterns and RGB tables, literal-only LZW independently packed. Expectations fixed before collection, never changed to match Chromium. Bounded separate parser traverses all frames; independent production-decoder validation remains unqualified.
